talks.talk: Advertising in the Age of AI
talks.read: Dresser framed advertising as shifting from a media operating model to an 'intelligence operating model,' arguing brands must build capabilities to compete in AI-native ecosystems. OpenAI also showcased Codex for automating marketer workflows. Anthropic, by contrast, has publicly opposed ads inside AI assistants, creating a visible philosophical divide on stage and off.

talks.talk: Robots Can't Build Brands: The New S-Curve of Creative Transformation
talks.read: Pritchard presented as 'ChatPG,' a self-styled AI agent, answering six questions on the future of brand building. He identified three forces in motion — media fragmentation, media-commerce convergence, and the AI turbocharge — and argued AI combined with human creativity acts like 'turbochargers' while brand fundamentals remain constant. He demonstrated in-house P&G campaigns for Secret and Tide Evo Detergent, stating measurement should ultimately focus on retail sales growth.

talks.talk: Day 2 Awards Show: Entertainment & Craft Track
talks.spk: Simon Cook (CEO, LIONS); Jury Presidents across 8 categories
talks.read: The ceremony awarded 169 Lions across Design, Digital Craft, Entertainment, Gaming, Music, Sport, Film Craft and Industry Craft. Handcraft dominated the narrative: Apple TV's human-made rebrand, De'Longhi's miniature cafés and Coinbase's cinematic film were praised for depth over technology. adidas and Johannes Leonardo became the festival's first double Grand Prix winners. Oprah Winfrey received the LionHeart Award on stage.

talks.talk: Day 3 Awards Show: Data, Direct, Media, PR & Social Track
talks.spk: Simon Cook (CEO, LIONS); Jury Presidents across 5 categories
talks.read: The ceremony celebrated purpose-led and service-design work. AXA's domestic violence insurance clause (Direct) and Indian Railways' lottery-ticket boarding pass (PR) were praised for rewriting category assumptions. Dove's Pinterest algorithm partnership won Media. GoDaddy's Walton Goggins-led B2B campaign won Creative Data and marked the brand's first-ever Lion entry and win. Vaseline Verified took Social & Creator for the second Lion of the festival.
